burst_detector.rule: window GyrX RMS > mult x median airborne window RMS

bursts.ABSOLUTE_SIZE_ANNOTATION: the burst detector is RELATIVE (a multiple of this run's own median airborne window RMS). peak_window_rms_deg_s is the absolute size and must be read alongside it: a run whose median is 0.004 deg/s will report 'bursts' that are physically negligible.
